text:
okoye: customer hit duplicate onboarding charges. quickstart (python v0.9.2) retried after a 429 while token rotation was happening; two sessions created. logs: 
```
WARN POST /v1/sessions 429 {"retry_after":0.6}
DEBUG token refresh start
DEBUG retrying POST /v1/sessions id=null
INFO POST /v1/sessions 201 id=sess_xyz
```
jon: that is unsafe replay. without an Idempotency-Key retries look like new requests. quick fix is to show header in sampleapp.
sahil: +1. also ensure SDK uses exponential backoff + full jitter to avoid thundering. node/go SDKs already have idempotency helpers; python quickstart missing it.
clare: policy question: should SDK auto-add idempotency for mutates? that can break apps expecting multiple creates. prefer opt-in with clear docs.
kevin: proposal: SDK defaults = exp backoff with full jitter, NOT auto-idempotency. expose helper to set Idempotency-Key and an opt-in flag. suggested knobs: retry.base_ms=100, retry.max_ms=2000, retry.attempts=5, safe_replay_window_s=10. sample snippet to demonstrate: 
```python
import uuid
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())}
requests.post(url, json=body, headers=headers)
```
okoye: i'll open a tiny PR to the quickstart showing idempotency header injection, add a short onboarding note about refresh+429 races, and link the retry playbook.
ci-bot: ticket created: INT-2178 python-sdk-idempotency-parity. PR draft: github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/92
okoye: thanks all. i'll post PR/ticket links here when ready. :thumbsup:
